title: zazz-sdk verification
description: Checks that cover the whole crate. The tests are unit tests in each module of src/ and src/test/; results are readings and live with CI.

entities.title: Unit tests on macOS and Linux
entities.summary: Each module's tests run in the workspace test on both platforms; native.rs and fdpass.rs are tested over real Unix socket pairs.
entities.details: wasm.rs is compiled only for WASM targets (#[cfg(target_family = "wasm")] in lib.rs), so these host tests do not run it; it runs when zazzled's zazz tests build and call real scripts, which is why the test job installs the wasm32-wasip1 target.
criteria: Every test in zazz-sdk passes on macOS and on Linux

entities.title: Branch coverage of at least 95%
entities.summary: CI fails when the tests cover less than 95% of zazz-sdk's branches, test code excluded.
criteria: cargo llvm-cov reports at least 95% branch coverage for -p zazz-sdk

checks.description: Run in macos/rust by the coverage job (nightly toolchain); test modules carry coverage(off).

entities.title: Builds with the workspace's minimum Rust
entities.summary: The crate compiles with Rust 1.85, the workspace's rust-version.
criteria: cargo check succeeds with the 1.85 toolchain
